hypothesis: The recoverable historical correction is the population mean of gate-weighted expert-function drift.

algebra.mixture_equivalence: Adding the same correction to every selected expert is equivalent to adding it once at the mixture output because sum_e g_e = 1.
algebra.gate_weighting_note: d_g is already gate-weighted, so applying d_g at the mixture output preserves its intended relationship to delta_e.

bootstrap.stratification: 20 classes x 100 test images per class

interpretation_guard: A destructive residual-only result is not by itself proof that residual structure is a nuisance mechanism, because residual magnitude may be large. Report it as sensitivity to a large off-direction perturbation.
